Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors Has Decreased Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $639,443 as Stock Rose; Dillon & Associates Has Lowered Its Qualcomm (QCOM) Position by $429,300
June 6, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 43.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors sold 3,829 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,885 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $820,000, down from 8,714 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.15B market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $193.31. About 19.54M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Dillon & Associates Inc decreased its stake in Qualcomm (QCOM) by 33.26% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dillon & Associates Inc sold 7,950 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 15,953 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $877,000, down from 23,903 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dillon & Associates Inc who had been investing in Qualcomm for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $87.45 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.46% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $58.98. About 5.60 million shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has risen 2.58% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
